note:
No private data and no invented genotypes: every genotype is the real 1000 Genomes call of the named sample.
What is simulated is only which sites a file contains:

cases.title: Sparse consumer array
cases.description: Consumer-array-like file: the sites a direct-to-consumer array assays.
cases.derivation: simulated array: reference-panel sites whose rsID is assayed on the public 23andMe genomes bundled with ClawBio
